Aircraft.Instructions: Homemade aircraft.Made in AKM2498K146. Noob production,Please don't be critical or abusive. Thank you~ (although I think it's better that no one talks) 1.Open the cockpit door (cockpit canopy) 2.Ejection device (automatic parachute deployment) 3.Drogue parachute 4.Thrust reverser in position (Brake) 5.Directly fire (throw) the leftmost and rightmost missiles (to prevent uneven gravity of single missile) 6.Direct fire (throw) of two missiles near the middle (to prevent uneven gravity of single missile) 8.Engine Start & Stop
